description: a when handler firing is itself one charged instruction, exactly as every other handler kind is: the empty-bodied start handler is delivered and its firing consumes the instruction that print 9 would otherwise have had, so an instruction budget of 2 raises ol-limit and nothing is printed. An implementation that charged bodies but not firings prints 9 and completes cleanly, so the fixture flips on the rule it names

diagnostics.message: this program ran 2 instructions without finishing, which is the configured safety limit — check for a loop that never ends, such as an unbounded 'forever' or 'while' whose condition never becomes false.
